ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
Residential Planned Development Number 723 District symbols and indications as shown
on Map No. 14-D and 16-D in the area bound by:

      South Ingleside Avenue; East 63rd Street; South Ellis Avenue; the alley next north of and
      parallel to East 63rd Street; South Greenwood Avenue; a line 141 feet north of and
      parallel to East 63rd Street; a line 180.86 feet east of and parallel to South Greenwood
      Avenue; a line 257 feet north of and parallel to East 63rd Street; South University
      Avenue; a line 252.3 feet north of and parallel to East 63rd Street; South Woodlawn
      Avenue; East 64th Street; South University Avenue; East 63rd Street; South Greenwood
      Avenue; a line 150 feet south of parallel to East 63rd Street; the alley next west of and
      parallel to South Greenwood Avenue; and the alley next south of and parallel to East
      63rd Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          ____________________________
                                                          Jeanette B. Taylor
                                                          Alderwoman, 20th Ward




Common Address:
935 – 1043 E. 63rd Street
1153 – 1169 E. 63rd Street
1000 – 1178 E. 63rd Street
6310 – 6336 S. Woodlawn Avenue
6311 – 6337 S. University Avenue
